summary: Purple Biotech Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K reporting results of its Annual General Meeting held September 8, 2026, at its Rehovot, Israel offices. All proposals described in the July 29, 2026 proxy statement were approved by the requisite shareholder vote under the Israeli Companies Law, 5759-1999 and the company's articles. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed. The filing is incorporated by reference into numerous Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. This is a routine meeting-results notice, not a special situation; no risk-arbitrage angle applies.
